title: Rioter
summary: RI'OTER, noun 1. One who indulges in loose festivity or excessive feasting. 2. In law, one guilty of meeting with others to do an unlawful act, and declining to retire upon proclamation.

inlines.v: RI'OTER, noun 1. One who indulges in loose festivity or excessive feasting. 2. In law, one guilty of meeting with others to do an unlawful act, and declining to retire upon proclamation.
